scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared-types && npm run build -w packages/engine && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w packages/shared-types && npm run build -w packages/engine
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/engine && npm run test -w apps/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/shared-types && npm run typecheck -w packages/engine && npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
